notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1
notes.content:
- Texture and graphics upgrade within the following scenes and locations:
   - Main scene
   - Airship
   - 221b Baker St
- Enhanced support for Oculus Touch controllers, including controller UI
- Added new calibration features that allow the user to use the app freely within their space, in any direction
- Included new targeting reticle within calibration scene to improve position accuracy
- Added new slider to the Menu UI to control Grayscale intensity
